data.title: Cleveland is using AI to flag property problems and fight blight. Here's how it works.
data.description: In late 2025, Cleveland teamed up with City Detect, a company that uses visual AI to help local governments monitor property conditions. The yearlong pilot project is scheduled to end Feb. 1.
